summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 3.7 Flash, an updated Flash-series model with claimed gains in coding, web development and knowledge-work benchmarks over Gemini 3.6 Flash, offered at an introductory price for the rest of 2026 before reverting to a higher rate in 2027.

mechanisms.reason: The model powers Gemini Spark, described as a personal agent that runs continuously and takes multi-step actions across Workspace apps.
mechanisms.quote: We launched Spark at I/O as your personal AI agent that runs 24/7, taking action on your behalf while under your direction.

practices.reason: Stated benchmark deltas versus the prior Flash model would prompt evaluation of whether the gains hold for our coding and workflow-automation use cases before switching.
practices.quote: It also achieves higher first-pass code accuracy and has improved performance in generating production-ready code as seen in FrontierCode 1.1 Main (43.6% vs 34.4%) and DeepSWE v1.1 (65.3% vs 49.0%).

practices.reason: A scheduled price increase on a fixed date requires teams to plan for higher per-token costs after the introductory period ends.
practices.quote: Introductory pricing expires on December 31, 2026. Starting January 1, 2027, $1.50/1M input tokens and $7.50/1M output tokens will apply.
